proposal_title: T2 — Topological Ringdown Meter (Topo-RDM) add-on to DSI-RDM

hypotheses.statement: Ringdown residuals exhibit nontrivial loop topology in time–frequency skeleton: max standardized first Betti number B1z_max >= 5 after FDR control (q<=0.01).
Topological spectrum peak aligns with DSI comb spacing within ±5% when DSI G1 passes.
Null controls (Kerr-only and phase-shuffled residuals) yield B1z_max < 3 in 95% of runs (empirical false-positive rate <= 0.05).
